extraction.name: FLEURS
extraction.description: FLEURS is an n-way parallel speech dataset in 102 languages built on top of the machine translation FLoRes-101 benchmark, with approximately 12 hours of speech supervision per language.
extraction.creator: Alexis Conneau (Meta AI Research); Min Ma (Google Research); Simran Khanuja (Google Research); Yu Zhang (Google Research); Vera Axelrod (Google Research); Siddharth Dalmia (Carnegie Mellon University); Jason Riesa (Google Research); Clara Rivera (Google Research); Ankur Bapna (Google Research)

extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset was collected by taking sentences from the FLoRes-101 dataset and having three different native speakers record each sentence. The recordings were then evaluated by workers to ensure they matched the input sentence, and invalid recordings were discarded.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: About 21.5% of the sentences are missing in the first version of the dataset because none of the three recordings for those sentences were validated.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: The source data consists of sentences from the FLoRes-101 dataset, which were originally extracted from English Wikipedia and translated into 101 languages by human translators.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Each recording is evaluated by additional workers to assesses whether the recording corresponds to the input sentence.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: In the first version of the dataset, about 21.5% of the sentences are missing because none of the three recordings were validated.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset aims to enable speech technology in more languages, catalyze research in low-resource speech understanding, and enable progress towards building speech technologies for everyone.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR); Speech Language Identification (Speech LangID); Speech-to-Text and Speech-to-Speech Translation; Multilingual Speech-to-Speech and Speech-to-Text Retrieval
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: We plan to fill these gaps in the future versions of the dataset.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Invalid recordings are discarded. Text sentences undergo NFC and FST normalization, lower-casing, and punctuation removal. Words are split into characters, and the token | is defined as word boundaries.
